status: D0-D2 approved by the owner 2026-11-08 and STAGED (not submitted) as LONI_staging/chiral_d0_vasp_mba2pbi4 via examples/scripts/prepare_chirality_d0.py; no package number yet. Everything from D3 on remains PROPOSED ONLY.

electronic_structure_profile.label_target: r2SCAN+D3(BJ), the project label profile (same INCAR family as data/prerelax_a0/dataset_v2: METAGGA=R2SCAN, IVDW=12, VDW_S8=0.7898, VDW_A1=0.4948, VDW_A2=5.7308, ENCUT=520, PREC=Accurate, LASPH=.TRUE., ISMEAR=0, SIGMA=0.05)
electronic_structure_profile.differences_from_slab_profile: bulk cells: no LDIPOL/IDIPOL; k-mesh from convergence step D0; ISYM=0 for the mirror-pair check
electronic_structure_profile.SOC: off for structural sampling; SOC on/off force comparison on 3 frames (D0c) decides whether that is acceptable
never_mix_with: Pols et al. SCAN values (reference only)

dft_validation_matrix.what: k-mesh/ENCUT convergence, R cell (188 atoms): 2x2x1, 3x3x1, 4x4x1; ENCUT 520/600
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: convergence of forces (target < 5 meV/A change) and R-rac energy difference (< 1 meV/f.u.)

dft_validation_matrix.what: timing benchmark: one r2SCAN single point of R at the D0a mesh
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: replace the inferred cost below with a measured one before anything else is submitted

dft_validation_matrix.what: SOC on/off on 3 frames (R relaxed, R 358 K snapshot, rac relaxed)
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: force/stress difference from SOC; if > 20 meV/A in Pb-I environments, SOC enters the structural protocol

dft_validation_matrix.what: relaxations: R and rac, fixed experimental cell then full cell (ISIF=3)
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: DFT reference minima; static descriptors tau_ax/eq/org of the relaxed cells

dft_validation_matrix.what: mirror check: single point of the exact inversion of relaxed R (ISYM=0)
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: E(R) = E(S) to numerical tolerance and forces map by the inversion; checks settings, not physics

dft_validation_matrix.what: NH3+ rotation scan about C*-N, one cation, 0-120 deg in 10 deg steps, rigid then constrained-relaxed endpoints; R and rac
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: rotational profile and barrier; H-bond rearrangement path

dft_validation_matrix.what: C*-C(ipso) ring torsion scan, 0-360 deg in 30 deg steps; R and rac
methyl rotor scan (control restraint target), 0-120 deg in 20 deg steps; R
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: barrier of the control motion used in the restraint intervention

dft_validation_matrix.what: octahedral tilt/twist displacement patterns (+/- 2 amplitudes x 3 patterns); R
in-plane biaxial strain +/-1 %, +/-2 %; R and rac
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: stress labels and strain coupling (needed for NPT)

dft_validation_matrix.what: finite-T frames: 30 decorrelated frames per system (R, rac) per T (173, 293, 358 K) from short pre-relaxer MD
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: training/validation pool; split by trajectory, never by neighbouring frames

dft_validation_matrix.what: held-out final test: independent seeds, 10 frames per system per T, plus the rac rotation scan
dft_validation_matrix.purpose: final test set; never used for fitting or active-learning selection

dft_cost_estimate.basis: [I] package 53: ~3 node-h per static and ~1 node-h per ionic step for a 504-atom slab on 2 x 64 cores. A 188-atom bulk cell with a 3x3x1 mesh is estimated at 0.3-1 node-h per single point. D0b replaces this with a measurement.
dft_cost_estimate.first_tranche_for_approval: D0a-D0c + D1 + D2 (about 30-120 node-h); everything else waits for D0b timing and the D1 minima

mlip_acceptance_criteria_fixed_before_pr.forces_heldout: per environment (N-H, C-H, C, N, Pb, I_axial, I_bridging): RMSE <= 0.05 eV/A and none > 0.08 eV/A on D9
mlip_acceptance_criteria_fixed_before_pr.static_descriptors: relaxed MLIP vs relaxed DFT (D1): same sign for every net tau; |delta net tau| <= 25 % of the DFT value; per-link tau within 0.02
mlip_acceptance_criteria_fixed_before_pr.rotational_profiles: D3/D4/D5 barriers within max(20 meV, 15 %) of DFT; profile RMSE <= 10 meV
mlip_acceptance_criteria_fixed_before_pr.relative_energy: R vs rac energy difference within 10 meV per formula unit
mlip_acceptance_criteria_fixed_before_pr.stress: within 0.3 GPa on D7 if NPT is used
mlip_acceptance_criteria_fixed_before_pr.mirror: E(R) = E(inverted R) and mapped forces (automatic for O(3)-invariant MACE; reported, but it is not evidence of accuracy)
mlip_acceptance_criteria_fixed_before_pr.note: foundation MACE-matpes-r2scan has 0.07-0.085 eV/A force RMSE near DFT minima of FAPbI3 slab complexes and no chiral-spacer data; it is expected to fail these criteria without fine-tuning

systems.S: exact inversion of relaxed R (never the separately refined S crystal)

md_matrix.cell: 2x2x1 of the conventional cell (R/S: 752 atoms; rac: 376 atoms); decisive comparison repeated in 4x4x1 (3008 / 1504 atoms)
md_matrix.temperature_rationale: 173 K = chiral X-ray temperature; 293 K = racemate X-ray temperature and room temperature; 358 K = 85 C device stress test, 82 K below the racemate melting point (166.5 C). Phase transitions of the chiral phase in 173-358 K are NOT verified: check the DSC literature before approval.
md_matrix.protocol: NPT (anisotropic, MTK or Berendsen-then-MTK) 25 ps equilibration -> NVT at the mean NPT cell 250 ps production -> 3 x 20 ps NVE segments from production snapshots for time correlations; timestep 0.5 fs, frames every 10 fs
md_matrix.matched_cell_control: R at 358 K in the 293 K mean cell (and vice versa) to separate temperature from volume/strain
md_matrix.intervention: R at 293 K: harmonic restraint on every NH3+ rotor dihedral (H-N-C*-C_ipso) with k = 0.5, 2, 10 eV/rad^2 (3 seeds each); control: same k on the methyl rotor dihedral (3 seeds at k = 2). Changes the Hamiltonian: mechanistic probe only. Restraint code is NOT implemented yet.
stop_conditions: any Pb loses or gains an I (coordination != 6)
committee/uncertainty above the D9-calibrated threshold for > 1 % of frames
production not converged by block averaging -> extend once to 1 ns, then report inconclusive

md_cost_estimate.measured: [M] 2026-11-08, laptop RTX 5070, MACE-matpes-r2scan foundation model, ASE calculator, float32: 0.38 s per energy+forces+stress call for 752 atoms (float64: 5.8 s; the 188-atom cell is slower per call because of neighbour-list overhead)
md_cost_estimate.per_run_laptop: 275 ps / 0.5 fs = 5.5e5 steps x 0.38 s = ~58 h for a 752-atom run
md_cost_estimate.total_gpu_hours_laptop_equivalent: ~3500-4000 (45 runs x 58 h, rac runs about half; 6 large-cell runs at ~4x per step)
md_cost_estimate.note: A fine-tuned model may run at a different speed; LAMMPS-MACE or cuequivariance on an A100/H100 should be benchmarked before any HPC request. These numbers are not an authorization.
